benefits.hotel_excerpt: Priority Upgrade if Available at Check-in

benefits.note: WhataHotel says suites carry a higher credit; the closing says so
independent hotel: the hotel page is the only WhataHotel source

closing.text: Book through WhataHotel's preferred rate and you'll get priority for an upgrade at check-in when one is available, free Wi-Fi access, complimentary daily breakfast for two, and a $100 hotel credit, or $200 for suites. That preferred-rate offer can also be combined with the hotel's listed exclusive perks, subject to each offer's terms.
